title: Add transport for pretty-printing envelope contents when debugging span-first logic
author: ericapisani
body_preview: Quality of life feature.   It's currently annoying to pull and log the contents of an envelope, so having a transport that handles this for us that's easily toggled would make life easier for developers working in the span-first logic.

title: Remove try/excepts that exist for Python 2 compatibility
